title: F# rule candidate (v2)
description: Observation-only rule candidate extracted from qualified repair episodes. v2 was introduced in ACT-CIRCUS-FSHARP-DIAGNOSTIC-RULE-CANDIDATE-EXTRACTION01-CORRECTION01 to restore the candidate/advice boundary, partition transitions by assessment authority, and remove imperative repair text. v1 had already been published as a compatibility surface and must not be silently mutated; consumers reading v1 artifacts must migrate to v2.

candidate_id.description: SHA-256 hash over canonical encodings of all identity-bearing fields, recomputed by the verifier.

status.description: Status in the curation pipeline. Only 'proposed' is permitted by v2.

evidence_strength.description: Strength of evidence supporting this candidate.

title.description: Concise descriptive title for the candidate. Never imperative.

applicability_conditions.description: Conditions under which this candidate may apply.

observation.description: Specific observation from the supporting episode.

candidate_hypothesis.description: Provisional, descriptive hypothesis. Never instructs an agent to modify code.

primary_path.description: Primary file path involved in the repair.

diagnostic_codes.description: Distinct diagnostic codes that were observed.

diagnostic_count.description: Number of transitions in the supporting group.

earliest_line.description: Earliest line number where diagnostics occurred (null if unknown).

changed_paths.description: Paths changed in the repair commit.

causal_family_curated.description: Always false in v2. Set true only by an explicit causal-family curation act.

repair_advice_available.description: Always false in v2. Repair advice must never be embedded in a candidate.

llm_tip_available.description: Always false in v2. LLM tips must never be embedded in a candidate.

context_transition_ids.description: Unassessable, ambiguous, exact-persistence, or source-removed transitions attached for context.
